ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels located on the distal lobes and 60% low-intensity dark-grey pixels concentrated in the central and trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-contrast white regions occupy the outer thirds of the fluke; a large, contiguous dark pigmentation zone covers the central region from the peduncle to the trailing edge, with significant dark mottling and bleeding into the white distal zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of peaks is greatest on the outer lobes, becoming more shallow and rounded toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering into an upward sweep toward the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a generally horizontal orientation with local jagged variations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white-ringed pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed throughout the dark central region and left white lobe; distinct grouping of four rings visible in the lower-central dark zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional linear pixel disruptions; prominent vertical rake marks are visible on the dark central surface and dark diagonal scratching is visible on the white distal portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular barnacle attachment scars across the ventral surface; distinct physical trauma or notch on the upper leading edge of the left lobe tip; three live barnacles attached to the trailing edge of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of dark, irregular blotches near the left distal tip and significant dark trailing edge border extending into the white field of the right lobe.
